message.content:
A magazine cover features a vertical red bar on the left and a light blue background. At the top, white text reads "10 PARTAI VERSI KPU" and "LAPORAN TEMPO DARI GAZA" separated by a thin vertical line. Below, the large white word "TEMPO" sits above "EDISI 14-20 JANUARI 2013". The main headline in large red and black block letters says "PONTEN MERAH SEKOLAH ELITE". Smaller black text underneath states "Rintisan Sekolah Bertaraf Internasional dihapuskan. Dinilai diskriminatif terhadap rakyat kecil."

The illustration shows a young person wearing a white short-sleeved collared shirt, maroon shorts, and a maroon and white cap, standing on a red carpet. The person carries a blue rolling suitcase and scratches their head with one hand. The red carpet extends from the bottom right towards the upper left, where it transforms into a set of stairs. At the top of the stairs, the red carpet material is rolled into a cylinder. The entire scene is set against a plain light blue backdrop. In the bottom left, price information, a website, and a barcode are visible.
